name: Potong Pasir
summary: Compact north-east Line town with a village feel, older HDB character, and quick NEL hops — small footprint, strong identity, limited new stock.
body: Potong Pasir punches above its size: a tight HDB estate with a neighbourhood centre, NEL access, and a loyal ‘village’ reputation among locals. Expats shortlist it when they want central-northeast commute value without Sengkang build-out noise or Orchard rents. Housing is overwhelmingly older HDB with scarce condo alternatives — whole-flat hunts need patience. Lifestyle is kopitiam and park-connector, not nightlife. Watch renovation seasons in mature blocks, limited family-condo options, and the reality that ‘close to town’ still means verifying your exact walk to the MRT. Compare with Bendemeer / Kallang for central-east variety, Serangoon for NEX mall gravity, and Toa Payoh for denser NSL hawker towns.
bestFor: renters who like compact mature estates
households okay with older HDB stock
car-light lives near Potong Pasir MRT
watchOuts: Small estate — fewer backup mall options on foot
housingMix: Mature HDB dominant; scarce condo pockets.
commuteNotes: North-East Line at Potong Pasir. Test door-to-desk on a weekday peak; estate is compact but MRT walk varies by block.
